local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local hum = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

-- === CHARACTER PREPARATION ===
local oldAutoRotate = hum.AutoRotate
local oldSit = hum.Sit

-- stop all animations
for _, v in ipairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
	v:Stop(0)
end

-- disable physics control
hum.Sit = true
hum.AutoRotate = false
hum.PlatformStand = true

hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

-- ghost mode
local originalCollisions = {}
local function setGhost(state)
	for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			if state then
				originalCollisions[obj] = obj.CanCollide
				obj.CanCollide = false
				obj.Massless = true
			else
				if originalCollisions[obj] ~= nil then
					obj.CanCollide = originalCollisions[obj]
				end
				obj.Massless = false
			end
		end
	end
end

setGhost(true)

-- === CANCEL TOKEN HOOK ===
-- The emote wheel passes a token via the environment.
-- If _cancelToken is set and becomes cancelled, we clean up and abort.
local _token = rawget(getfenv(0), "_cancelToken") -- nil if not run from wheel

-- Declare as upvalues FIRST so doCleanup can always close over them
local conn
local track
local checkpoint
local finished = false  -- shared flag so the loop stops immediately on cleanup
local poseTracks = {}   -- all playPose tracks so we can kill them on cancel

local function doCleanup()
    finished = true
    pcall(function() if conn then conn:Disconnect() end end)
    pcall(function() if track then track:Stop(0) end end)
    for _, pt in ipairs(poseTracks) do
        pcall(function() pt:Stop(0) end)
    end
    pcall(function() hrp.Anchored = false end)
    pcall(function() setGhost(false) end)
    pcall(function() hum.PlatformStand = false end)
    pcall(function() hum.Sit = oldSit end)
    pcall(function() hum.AutoRotate = oldAutoRotate end)
    pcall(function() if checkpoint and checkpoint.Parent then checkpoint:Destroy() end end)
end

-- animation (optional placeholder)
local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://0"
track = hum:LoadAnimation(animation)
track:Play(1, 5, 1)
track:AdjustSpeed(0.01)

-- checkpoint target
checkpoint = Instance.new("Part")
checkpoint.Size = hrp.Size
checkpoint.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
checkpoint.Anchored = true
checkpoint.CanCollide = false
checkpoint.Transparency = 1
checkpoint.Parent = workspace

}

-- transform helper
local origin = frames[1]:Inverse()
local startCFrame = hrp.CFrame

local function getRelative(cf)
	return startCFrame * (origin * cf)
end

-- === MAIN TIMELINE CONFIGURATION ===
local targetFPS = 55        -- Framerate your recorder captured at
local playbackSpeed = 1.05    -- Change speed here (e.g. 2.0 = 2x speed, 0.5 = half speed)

local totalFrames = #frames
-- Total base duration adjusted by playback speed multiplier
local totalDuration = ((totalFrames - 1) / targetFPS) / playbackSpeed

local function calculateMainTimeline(elapsedTime)
	if elapsedTime >= totalDuration then
		return totalFrames, 1, true
	end
	
	local progress = elapsedTime / totalDuration
	local scaledIndex = progress * (totalFrames - 1) + 1
	local index = math.floor(scaledIndex)
	local alpha = scaledIndex - index
	
	return index, alpha, false
end

-- RUNTIME LOOP
local startTime = tick()
-- (finished and conn declared above as upvalues so doCleanup can reach them)

conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if finished then return end

	-- abort if wheel cancelled this emote
	if _token and _token.cancelled then
		doCleanup()
		return
	end

	local currentTime = tick()
	local elapsedTime = currentTime - startTime
	local index, alpha, isFinished = calculateMainTimeline(elapsedTime)

	if isFinished or index >= totalFrames then
		finished = true
		conn:Disconnect()
		track:Stop(0)

		-- snap back to start position (no anchor risk)
		hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		hrp.CFrame = checkpoint.CFrame

		if checkpoint and checkpoint.Parent then
			checkpoint:Destroy()
		end

		-- restore state
		setGhost(false)
		hum.PlatformStand = false
		hum.Sit = oldSit
		hum.AutoRotate = oldAutoRotate

		return
	end

	local nextIndex = math.min(index + 1, totalFrames)
	local a = getRelative(frames[index])
	local b = getRelative(frames[nextIndex])

	hrp.CFrame = a:Lerp(b, alpha)
	hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
end)
local SPEED_MULTIPLIER = 1

local function playPose(animId, fadeTime, timePos, speed, stopDelay, waitTime)
	if finished then return end
	if _token and _token.cancelled then return end
	local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
	anim.AnimationId = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?version=1&id=" .. animId
	local pt = hum:LoadAnimation(anim)
	table.insert(poseTracks, pt)
	pt:Play(fadeTime)
	pt.TimePosition = timePos
	pt:AdjustSpeed(speed * SPEED_MULTIPLIER)

	local scaledStopDelay = stopDelay / SPEED_MULTIPLIER
	task.delay(scaledStopDelay, function()
		pcall(function() pt:Stop(fadeTime) end)
	end)

	if waitTime then
		-- poll so we exit immediately if cancelled mid-wait
		local elapsed = 0
		local target = waitTime / SPEED_MULTIPLIER
		local stepSize = 0.03
		while elapsed < target do
			if finished or (_token and _token.cancelled) then return end
			local dt = task.wait(math.min(stepSize, target - elapsed))
			elapsed = elapsed + dt
		end
	end
end

playPose(21632926, 0, 0, 1, 9, nil)
playPose(94853940, 0.5, 0, 1, 9, nil)
playPose(188854226, 0, 0.3, 0, 0.8, 0.8)
playPose(188853932, 0, 0.3, 0, 0.8, 0.8)
playPose(188854226, 0, 0.3, 0, 0.8, 0.8)
playPose(188853932, 0, 0.3, 0, 0.8, 0.8)
playPose(89280035, 0.1, 0, 1, 3.1, 3.1)
playPose(188853932, 0, 0.3, 0, 0.8, 0.8)
playPose(188854226, 0, 0.3, 0, 0.8, 0.8)
playPose(188853932, 0, 0.3, 0, 0.8, 0.8)
playPose(188854226, 0, 0.3, 0, 0.8, nil)
